meta.rule: A hotel is usable for an 8 AM–close day only if the walk from the lobby to the poker room can be completed inside 30 minutes.
meta.how_to_close: replace the pace-derived minutes with a duration from a routing service that publishes one for walking, or with a timed walk by hand, and record the door end of each route instead of the building centroid; the per-pair values in data/f0d7de66/walks.json are the ones to overwrite, and tools/f0d7de66_walks.py re-validates the captures behind them.
meta.method: OpenStreetMap foot-route length between each property's building point and each event room's building point, converted to minutes at a stated pace
